tei:div.tei:p: 'od snang las grub gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus// rta babs spangs pa'i rin chen gzhal med khang*// mtha' skor ta la'i ljon pa spos chu'i klung*// dbus su pad+ma stong ldan ge sar steng*// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan bcu drug rnams// nyan thos dgra bcom mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te gshegs su gsol// nyer spyod bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// yan lag bdun pa'i shing rtas drangs te 'bul// rgyal ba ston mchog khyod kyi dam chos ni// mdo sde dang ni mngon pa'i sde snod de// bstan pa'i lam srol ji bzhin ston pa ni// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod nyid yin pas// de 'dzin 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug ni// slob pa min pa'i go 'phang brnyes zin kyang*// bstan 'gro'i don du nyan thos tshul bzung nas// bstan pa ma nub bar du bzhugs phyag 'tshal// dran pa nye bar gzhag pa sogs// rnam byang rgya mtsho'i mchod sdong che// gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i sku// ston pa drang srong la phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// gangs ri chen po ti se na// 'phags pa gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*// dgra bcom stong dang sum brgyas bskor// spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// drang srong ri yi shel nags la// 'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa// dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na// 'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas// dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor// sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// 'dzam bu gling gi zangs gling na// 'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni// dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor// gser gyi rna kor 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// siṅga la yi gling na ni// gnas brtan rdo rje mo yi bu// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// chu bo ya mu nā'i gling na// 'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni// dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor// chos 'chad mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// gnas mchog dam pa kha che na// 'phags pa gnas brtan gser be 'u// dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyas bskor// rin chen zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// nub kyi ba lang spyod na ni// bhā ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog

/dgra bcom chen po bdun brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni// 'phags pa gnas brtan bak+ku la// dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor// phyag g.yon ne'u le 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// pri yaṅku yi gling na ni// 'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan zin// dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor// rin chen prog zhu 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la// 'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran bstan// dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// shar gyi lus 'phags gling na ni// bhā ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// glegs bam lhung bzed 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na// 'phags pa gnas brtan lam bstan ni// dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor// glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs la// 'phags pa gnas brtan klu yi sde// dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor// bum pa 'khar gsil 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// ri yi rgyal po bhi hu lar// 'phags pa gnas brtan sbed byed ni// dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor// phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// ri yi rgyal po gangs can la// 'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa// dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor// byang chen mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// 'phags pa dge bsnyen dharma tā// ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khur// snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs// rnga yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rang rang 'khor 'dul sgo bzhi skyong*// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan dang de 'dzin rgyas byin rlobs// lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa mchog ldan gzugs// bstan pa'i gzhi ma dam chos 'dul ba ni// 'jigs skyob legs smon blo dang ma 'dres par// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal bden pa ru// shes nas de'i rgyu kun 'byung spong byed cing*// lam gyi bden pa las 'bras bslu med dang*// gzhan gnod gzhi bcas dge sbyong chos bzhi brtag

/nyis brgya lnga bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*// bcu bdun blang bya 'jug pa'i tshul khrims la// pham ltung nyes byas lhag ma'i skyon bral zhing*// gzhi gsum cho gas rnam par byang ba'i khams// rgyun du zhugs sogs dge sbyong 'bras bu bzhir// mngon par byang chub lhag pa'i bsam gtan dang*// lhag pa'i shes rab rnam par byang ba'i gzugs// dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i sa brgyad kyis// 'gog bden mngon gyur dgra bcom thob par shog / ces pa'ang mos ldan gyi slob ma'i mchog tu gyur pa nyi grags gsum pa rin po che'i ngor/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung rang sor bzhag la sngon rjes kyi tshigs bcad bsnan te rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rjes dbur stod 'bri gung du sbyar pa'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
